name: a match starts without its renderer
why: index.ts enterMatch: START no longer keeps the GameRender that wire() built for the room
find:
/\ seated' = TRUE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<boot, prefabs, link, scope, render, err
replace:
/\ seated' = TRUE /\ render' = FALSE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<boot, prefabs, link, scope, err

name: leaving keeps the seat
why: index.ts leaveAll(): the leave message is no longer sent, so the server keeps the seat

name: PLAY runs before ready
why: index.ts prepareIsland: no longer waits for dataset.ready, so Enter, a controller's A or a focused button presses PLAY before the prefabs exist: GameRender throws and nothing visible happens
find: /\ prefabs   \* after ready, kr.prepare() waits for the prefabs (main.ts:502-531)

name: CREATE or JOIN runs before ready
why: index.ts prepareIsland: no longer waits for dataset.ready, so an early CREATE or JOIN (an invite link, the event lobby's Join) wires a GameRender before the prefabs exist and strands the match scope

name: an AFK removal leaves the match on screen
why: server/lobby.ts housekeeping drops the player from the lobby again (no afk flag, no room frame), or index.ts no longer runs backToRoom on afk: the client stays on a match the server no longer plays for it
find:
/\ seated' = FALSE /\ err' = TRUE /\ why' = TRUE /\ view' = "room"
  /\ scope' = WireScopeAfter /\ render' = WireOk
  /\ UNCHANGED <<boot, prefabs, phase, link, silent, ctx, restores>>
replace:
/\ seated' = FALSE /\ err' = TRUE /\ why' = TRUE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<boot, prefabs, view, phase, link, scope, render, silent, ctx, restores>>
